dishes.name: Buttermilchgetzen
dishes.desc: Thin potato and buttermilk pancake baked or fried, eaten with sweet toppings or with sausage. Poor-household cooking from the Ore Mountains.

dishes.name: Falscher Hase
dishes.desc: Baked minced-meat loaf with a hard-boiled egg inside, served with gravy and potatoes. A Saxon and Ore Mountains Sunday dish.

dishes.name: Ochsenfetzen
dishes.desc: Strips of beef in a thick onion gravy, a hearty dish from the Ore Mountains kitchen, served with dumplings or potatoes.

dishes.name: Hutzenbrot
dishes.desc: Dense fruit bread of dried pears and nuts, baked in the Ore Mountains and Vogtland for winter.
